rules.new_licensee_rule: No CE for the biennium in which the license is first issued.
rules.accepted_credit_types: Courses sponsored or recognized by local, state, regional, national or international dental, dental hygiene, dental assisting or medical professional organizations; approved study groups

topics.who: Current CPR/AED; up to 2 CPR/AED hours count

rules.notes: Reporting period Oct 1 (odd year) - Sep 30 (next odd year). CE must relate to clinical dental hygiene or medicine. Current CPR/AED required; up to 2 CPR/AED hours count.
